channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its validator voting system with certificate-based consensus that targets near-instant transaction finality.

item.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first retail Bitcoin ETF
item.description: FINMA has approved a Swiss retail fund that holds Bitcoin directly, creating a new fund-law route for investors while requiring custody controls and risk disclosures.

item.title: Uniswap v4 adds outside liquidity on three chains
item.description: Uniswap’s v4 aggregator hooks went live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain, routing swaps across outside liquidity and directing protocol fees toward UNI burns.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s final stablecoin rule keeps the issuer yield ban but leaves platform rewards to case-by-case review, preserving room for exchanges while setting no safe harbor.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders directly but leaves exchange rewards open to case-by-case review from January 2027.

item.title: Rango Bridge routes swaps across chains, step by step
item.description: Rango Bridge finds paths across swaps, bridges and liquidity protocols, then coordinates the required transactions so tokens can move between blockchains.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards open to crypto exchanges
item.description: The OCC’s new stablecoin rule bars issuers from paying holders directly but leaves exchanges able to offer rewards case by case, preserving a key crypto revenue model.

item.title: Move Mantle Funds to Ethereum Escrow
item.description: To fund an Ethereum escrow with Mantle-held assets, withdraw to Ethereum, match the escrow’s token contract and amount, and keep gas for each chain step.

item.title: Exit a SpookySwap Farm Before Removing Liquidity
item.description: Unstake the farmed position first, then withdraw its liquidity through the matching pool or position controls; each step returns a different asset or claim.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin reward programs to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC finalized its GENIUS Act rule, barring issuers from paying yield solely for holding stablecoins while leaving other reward arrangements to case-by-case review.

item.title: SpookySwap Fee Tiers: Match the Pool to Your Trade
item.description: If your swap is pending or failed, compare the quoted output for your trade size before blaming the pool fee: a lower fee tier can still give you a worse…

item.title: DTCC sets October launch for tokenized securities service
item.description: DTCC plans to represent securities already held in its custody as blockchain tokens, with the same ownership rights and investor protections as traditional assets.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Market Makers Price From Inventory
item.description: Cross-chain market makers price each swap against the assets they can deliver, the inventory a trade will leave behind, and the cost of restoring balance.

item.title: How ZeroFi moves Monero into EVM apps
item.description: ZeroFi turns Monero deposits into zXMR on an EVM testnet, but developers must account for confirmation delays, redemption and the limits of the current bridge.

item.title: Set Swap Slippage for Repeat Trades by Starting With the Quote
item.description: For repeat swaps, set slippage from the quoted output and the pool’s behavior: too tight can revert; too wide can accept a worse fill than planned.

item.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Rules for Payment Stablecoins
item.description: The OCC finalized GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin reserves, redemptions and supervision, setting a January 18, 2027 start while leaving AML rules for later.

item.title: How to Finish a chainflip Swap, From Quote to Payout
item.description: A Chainflip swap runs from quote and deposit address through validator checks, market pricing and payout, with clear checks for fees, destination and refunds.

item.title: Mesh and Visa link wallet balances to 175 million merchants
item.description: Mesh and Visa will let participating wallet apps route crypto, stablecoin and fiat balances to Visa payments, avoiding a separate card while rollout details remain pending.

item.title: How to Choose a BaiBai Swap Quote
item.description: A swap quote is a route-specific estimate, not a promise: compare the tokens received after fees, then check slippage, network and execution limits.

item.title: Relay bridge routes: how to weigh speed, cost and settlement
item.description: A relay bridge quote is a choice between what arrives, how soon it arrives and what the route costs; compare the output and settlement before signing.
